title: Michael Johnson's visit and matching drawings
place_text: Hanes Way Apartments, Rapid City, South Dakota

tellings.quote: everything he saw the craft he saw the black sphere in front of the vehicle jumping up and down he smelled the smell he heard do not fear he heard all that and saw every bit of it
Let's do something here, man. I saw something. I want to write it down before I forget.
tellings.difference: Told by Michael himself, firsthand, rather than by Mario; it stresses that he wanted to write it down before forgetting.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Michael's visit to Mario's home in Rapid City, where Michael drew what he saw. This telling gives Michael's side of the visit that Mario describes.

as_told.title: Michael draws the alien at Mario's home before leaving

tellings.quote: Two weeks went by and Sgt. ------- came by my apartment, out of the blue, and we sat down and talked about the incident in front of my wife.
He had been terrified during the incident but didn't know why, as he had heard voices, many voices, saying not to be afraid.

plain: About two weeks after the night in 1977 when Mario Woods, an Air Force nuclear missile guard, says he was abducted, his fellow guard Michael Johnson is said to have turned up at his apartment in Rapid City, South Dakota, and described the same things: the craft, a black sphere jumping up and down in front of their vehicle, a strange smell and a voice saying "do not fear," and the two men's drawings of the craft matched. Woods tells this on the show and Johnson tells it himself, saying "I saw something. I want to write it down before I forget"; if true, it would mean a second witness backs Woods's story. The journalist Robert Hastings's 2017 article gives Woods's account with the sergeant's name blacked out, saying he "came by my apartment, out of the blue" and had been terrified because "he had heard voices, many voices, saying not to be afraid."
